keywords: 8141 是平台而 8130 是一站式方案
8250 与 8272 编号冲突修复合并
EIP-7999 多维费用市场均衡
summary: Barnabé 的 Ethlabs Week 10 回顾 AA 之周：8130 更像为钱包提供强默认值、限制功能的一站式方案，8141 更像账户平台，提供让协议无需干预即可扩展的原料；8141 被 SFI 后仍有机会吸收 8130 的想法。Ethlabs 提议在 Hegotá 完成缩短出块时间所需的改造，并先从 12 秒降到 10 秒。fradamt 发布 decoupled consensus 形式化的大更新。EIP-8250 和 EIP-8272 移开冲突编号的 PR 合并。当晚召开 ACDT #94。

keywords_en: 8141 as a platform and 8130 as a turnkey solution
summary_en: Barnabé's Ethlabs Week 10 looked back on a week of AA: 8130 is more of a turnkey solution that gives wallets strong defaults and restricts functionality, while 8141 is a platform for accounts with the raw ingredients to extend the protocol without intervention; 8141 being SFI does not end the chance to fold in ideas from 8130. Ethlabs proposes doing the work in Hegotá to let the chain lower its block time, starting with 12 seconds to 10. fradamt shipped a big update to the decoupled consensus formalization. The PRs moving EIP-8250 and EIP-8272 off clashing numbers were merged. ACDT #94 was held in the evening.
